description: Generate vector embeddings from text. Returns immediately with job_id and status queued; work runs on the plugin worker.
embedding_description: Queue text embeddings using the configured OpenAI-compatible server and optional model. Returns job_id and status queued before HTTP runs. Retrieve service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result contains the original embeddings, dimension and model response, and failures also retain job.error.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job handle with job_id and status; the final response is stored in job.result.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain this exact job_id. Schedule job_service::get_job while queued or processing; inspect terminal result or error before using the final data. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Generates vector embeddings from text using OpenAI-compatible API
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: API endpoint not reachable. ValidationError: Invalid input format or empty inputs. APIError: Backend service returned an error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: verify the embedding service is running. For validation errors: check input format is a list of strings.
